en.askTitle: Change the boxes to your own situation and get the same visa-income and budget check before you move
en.runTitle: Medellín developer and partner moving to Spain on the teleworker visa, Valencia or Málaga

fields.label: Age, occupation, type of income and who the clients are
fields.value: 30, backend developer working remotely as a contractor for a US company, USD 5,800 a month

fields.label: Partner or family and how the relationship is documented
fields.value: Partner Laura (29, freelance graphic designer, about USD 1,500 a month); not married, living together for 4 years

en.template: Help me plan a move from {from} to {to} on the teleworker visa. I am {me}, moving with {partner}. Check the income threshold on both readings of the SMI, the partner proof the Bogotá consulate asks for, and what I should ask a Spanish and a Colombian adviser about tax and Social Security. Rebuild the monthly budget with my own rent, income and savings figures, and flag anything unconfirmed. Ask before contacting anyone or paying anything.

phases.title: Research the visa rules, partner proof, rents, insurance and exchange rates, then write up and check the guide
phases.note: Income rule on both readings, partner papers, Valencia versus Málaga, monthly budget
phases.judgment: The official pages give the income rule only as percentages of the minimum wage (200% for the applicant, 75% for a partner), with no euro amounts. So it worked out both readings itself, €3,917.38 and €3,357.75, and said that which base the authorities use is unresolved.

workers: Collected dated rent examples and coworking prices in Valencia and Málaga and checked the rental deposit rules
Looked up official exchange rates, private health-insurance prices and flight fares from Colombia
